item.title: A-FACTORY Aomori: Apple Cider & Food Souvenirs — Guide
item.description: A stylish market building right by Aomori Station, A-FACTORY is the essential one-stop for Aomori food culture. A glass-walled cider brewery makes Aomori’s famous apple cider on-site, while the market hall sells apple juice, local sake, dried scallops and the prefecture’s best-curated edible souvenirs. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City (by Aomori Station) Hours ~10:00–19:00 (varies) Admission Free entry Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to Do Taste Aomori apple cider from the on-site brewery.

item.title: Aomori Furukawa Market: Build Your Own Nokkedon — Guide
item.description: The Furukawa Fish Market near Aomori Station is home to the famous ‘Nokkedon’ — you buy a bowl of rice and a book of tickets, then wander the stalls exchanging tickets for slices of tuna, scallop, salmon roe and whatever the morning’s catch brings, building your own custom seafood bowl. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City (near Aomori Station) Hours ~7:00–15:00 (closed some Tue) Admission Nokkedon tickets ~¥1,500–2,000 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Morning; year-round What to Try The build-your-own Nokkedon seafood rice bowl.

item.title: Aomori Nebuta Festival: Japan's Great Summer Festival — Guide
item.description: The Aomori Nebuta Festival is one of Japan’s three great festivals — and arguably its most spectacular. Each evening from August 2–7, giant illuminated warrior figures up to 9 m wide parade through Aomori City, accompanied by thousands of Haneto dancers chanting ‘Rassera!’ The final night sees floats carried out onto Aomori Bay with fireworks. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City, Aomori Hours Evenings, Aug 2–7 Admission Free to watch; paid seats ~¥2,000+ Time needed 2–3 hours Best time August 2–7 (fixed dates) Highlights Giant illuminated warrior floats up to 9 m wide.

item.title: Nebuta Museum WA RASSE: Aomori's Festival Year-Round — Guide
item.description: Right beside Aomori Station, the Nebuta Museum WA RASSE lets you experience Aomori’s greatest festival any day of the year. Five of the towering illuminated warrior floats from recent Nebuta Festivals are displayed indoors, close enough to see every brushstroke and wire. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City (by Aomori Station) Hours 9:00–18:00 (seasonal) Admission Around ¥620 Time needed About 1–1.

item.title: Nebuta Paper-Craft Workshop: Make a Lantern — Aomori Guide
item.description: The giant Nebuta floats are built from wire frames covered in painted washi paper and lit from within. In Aomori City workshops you can learn this craft in miniature — shaping wire, applying washi, and painting your own glowing mini Nebuta lantern to take home. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City, Aomori Hours By reservation Admission Workshop ~¥1,500 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to Expect Build a mini washi-and-wire lantern.

item.title: Sannai-Maruyama Jomon Site: UNESCO Ruins in Aomori — Guide
item.description: Sannai-Maruyama is one of Japan’s most important archaeological sites — a Jomon-period settlement inhabited for around 1,500 years, now a UNESCO World Heritage site. Reconstructed pit dwellings and the iconic six-pillared timber tower let you picture life 5,500 years ago. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City, Aomori Hours ~9:00–17:00 (seasonal) Admission Free (site) Time needed 1.

item.title: Tsugaru Vidro Glass: Blow Your Own in Aomori — Guide
item.description: Tsugaru Vidro (biidoro) is Aomori’s vivid handmade glass, its jewel colours echoing the region’s seas, forests and four seasons. Studios near Aomori City let you try glass-blowing to shape your own tumbler or ornament — a warm, memorable hands-on souvenir of your trip. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City area Hours By reservation Admission Experience ~¥3,000 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to Expect Blow your own glass tumbler or ornament.
